# Functions of qiime2R

read_qza() - Function for reading artifacts (.qza).

qza_to_phyloseq() - Imports multiple artifacts to produce a phyloseq object.

read_q2metadata() - Reads qiime2 metadata file (containing q2-types definition line).

write_q2manifest() - Writes a read manifest file to import data into qiime2.

theme_q2r() - A ggplot2 theme for publication-type figures.

print_provenance() - A function to display provenance information.

is_q2metadata() - A function to check if a file is a qiime2 metadata file.

parse_taxonomy() - A function to parse taxonomy strings and return a table where each column is a taxonomic class.

parse_ordination() - A function to parse the internal ordination format. 

# Nomenclature

The manuscript and code files may utilize different naming conventions for groups and treatments as follows:

**Manuscript Name**  | **Related Script Name(s)**
------------- | -------------
Sample Type  | Type
Microbial Depletion  | Depletion, Dep, or Treatment
Microbial Density  | Concentration, Con, PW_Percentage, or Percentage
Pond Source | Pond, or Pond_Treatment

# Data Descriptions

## Sample Type Subset

Tadpole gut, skin, and inhabited day 6 tank water samples to help visualize whether the three sample types cluster distinctly.

## Water Subset

Day 0 Uninhabited ("C" Control) Tanks vs Day 6 Inhabited Tanks PC2/PC3

## Skin Subset

# Plots {.tabset}

## Sample Type

```{r All PC1/PC2}
metadata1<-read_q2metadata("Tadpole_Metadata_SampleType_Q2.txt")
braycurtis1<-read_qza("/core-metrics-results-decontam-d500-sampletype/bray_curtis_pcoa_results.qza")
jaccard1<-read_qza("/core-metrics-results-decontam-d500-sampletype/jaccard_pcoa_results.qza")


cols <- c("#44AA99","#AA4499","#332288")
braycurtis1$data$Vectors %>%
  select(SampleID, PC1, PC2) %>%
  left_join(metadata1) %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_point(aes(x=PC1, y=PC2, color=`Type`, fill=`Type`),alpha=0.8)+
  theme_q2r()+ 
  xlab("PC1 (16.80%)")+
  ylab("PC2 (13.23%)")+
  scale_color_manual(
  values = cols,
  aesthetics = c("fill", "color"),
  name=NULL,
  )+
  guides(color=guide_legend(override.aes=list(size=3)))+
  theme(text=element_text(size=14), axis.text.x = element_text(size=11), axis.text.y = element_text(size=11), axis.title=element_text(size=12))

jaccard1$data$Vectors %>%
  select(SampleID, PC1, PC2) %>%
  left_join(metadata1) %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_point(aes(x=PC1, y=PC2, color=`Type`, fill=`Type`),alpha=0.8)+
  theme_q2r()+ 
  xlab("PC1 (10.30%)")+
  ylab("PC2 (7.34%)")+
  scale_color_manual(
  values = cols,
  aesthetics = c("fill", "color"),
  name=NULL,
  )+

  guides(color=guide_legend(override.aes=list(size=3)))+
  theme(text=element_text(size=14), axis.text.x = element_text(size=11), axis.text.y = element_text(size=11), axis.title=element_text(size=12))
```

## Water Samples

### D0 Uninhabited Tanks vs D6 Inhabited Tanks PC2/PC3

```{r Water D0-D6 PC2/PC3}
metadata7<-read_q2metadata("/core-metrics-results-water/Tadpole_Metadata_Water_Qiime2R.txt")
braycurtis7<-read_qza("/core-metrics-results-water/bray_curtis_pcoa_results.qza")
jaccard7<-read_qza("/core-metrics-results-water/jaccard_pcoa_results.qza")

#### BRAY CURTIS

cols <- c("#000000","#E69F00","#009E73")
fills <- c("#000000","#FFFFFF","#E69F00","#009E73")
b2<-braycurtis7$data$Vectors %>%
  select(SampleID, PC2, PC3) %>%
  left_join(metadata7)

b2a<-filter(b2,Keep == "Y") %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_point(aes(x=PC2, y=PC3, color=`Pond`, fill=`Fill`, shape=`Treatment`, size=`PW Percentage`),alpha=0.6)+
  theme_q2r()+ 
  xlab("PC2 (9.930%)")+
  ylab("PC3 (5.765%)")+
  scale_color_manual(
  values = cols,
  aesthetics = c("color"),
  name="Source",
  )+
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = fills,
    aesthetics = c("fill"),
    name = "Control",
    label=c("Yes","No","","")
  )+
  scale_size_manual(breaks=c(0,1,25,50,75,100),
                    labels=c("0","1","25","50","75","100"),
                    values=c(0.5,1,2.5,3.5,4.5,5.5))+
  guides(color=guide_legend(override.aes=list(color=c("#000000","#E69F00","#009E73"), size=3)))+
  scale_shape_manual(values=c(22,24,21,13), name="Treatment")+
  guides(shape=guide_legend(override.aes=list(size=3)))+
  theme(text=element_text(size=12), axis.text.x = element_text(size=11), axis.text.y = element_text(size=11), axis.title=element_text(size=12))
b2a

#### JACCARD

cols <- c("#000000","#E69F00","#009E73")
j2<-jaccard7$data$Vectors %>%
  select(SampleID, PC2, PC3) %>%
  left_join(metadata7)

j2a<-filter(j2,Keep == "Y") %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_point(aes(x=PC2, y=PC3, color=`Pond`, fill=`Fill`, shape=`Treatment`, size=`PW Percentage`),alpha=0.6)+
  theme_q2r()+ 
  xlab("PC2 (6.712%)")+
  ylab("PC3 (4.083%)")+
  scale_color_manual(
  values = cols,
  aesthetics = c("color"),
  name="Source",
  )+
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = fills,
    aesthetics = c("fill"),
    name = "Control",
    label=c("Yes","No","","")
  )+
  scale_size_manual(breaks=c(0,1,25,50,75,100),
                    labels=c("0","1","25","50","75","100"),
                    values=c(0.5,1,2.5,3.5,4.5,5.5))+
  guides(color=guide_legend(override.aes=list(color=c("#000000","#E69F00","#009E73"), size=3)))+
  scale_shape_manual(values=c(22,24,21), name="Treatment")+  guides(shape=guide_legend(override.aes=list(size=3)))+
  theme(text=element_text(size=12), axis.text.x = element_text(size=11), axis.text.y = element_text(size=11), axis.title=element_text(size=12))
j2a

a<-"1"
b<-"2"
c<-"3"
d<-"4"
e<-"5"
  
figure<-ggarrange(j2a, a, b2a, b, labels = c("","","",""), ncol=2, nrow=2,
          common.legend = TRUE, legend = "right")
figure
ggexport(figure, width=10, height=6, filename="Water_D0_D6_2.pdf", res=1200)
```

  theme(text=element_text(size=12), axis.text.x = element_text(size=11), axis.text.y = element_text(size=11), axis.title=element_text(size=12))
b2

#### JACCARD

cols <- c("#000000","#E69F00","#009E73")
j2<-jaccard6$data$Vectors %>%

  ggplot() +

                    labels=c("0","1","25","50","100"),

  scale_shape_manual(values=c(0,2,21), name="Treatment")+
  guides(shape=guide_legend(override.aes=list(size=3)))+
